sections.heading: Sell anything, right where you build.

claimsToVerify.phrase: Recurring plans plus gated content and memberships (Business & up).
claimsToVerify.concern: Not on the forbidden list, but it is a hard plan-gating promise stated in marketing copy. Confirm memberships really start at Business before this ships.

claimsToVerify.phrase: Product reviews and abandoned-cart recovery (Pro & up), plus a built-in commerce analytics dashboard.
claimsToVerify.concern: Same — verify the Pro-and-up gate for reviews and abandoned-cart recovery, and that both features exist today rather than being roadmap.

claimsToVerify.phrase: Stripe-powered checkout with taxes, discounts, and gift cards.
claimsToVerify.concern: Gift cards are the one item here not corroborated elsewhere in the frames. Verify gift cards ship before claiming them.
